title: Zesty Earthy Slovakian Mushroom Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Slovakian dish featuring earthy mushrooms, lemon zest, and a mirepoix base, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and easily adaptable to be dairy-free friendly.

ingredients.name: mixed mushrooms
ingredients.notes: such as cremini, shiitake, and button

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the mixed mushrooms, lemon zest, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, and simmer the stew, covered, for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
